integrity: Proof is analytic; finite rational-phase enumeration and Simpson quadratures are supplementary, not infinite certification. Asymptotic proof requires uniform parameter control and retains a specific unindexed-overlap risk.
scientific_limitations: Fixed support angle strictly between zero and pi; asymptotic as exponent approaches 3/2 from below on S^2 only; no explicit finite-deficit error bound, no endpoint-uniform estimate, and no independent audit.
title: Arithmetic first-sign barrier below the spherical Pólya threshold
